notes: Pricing: a Billed Monthly / Billed Yearly toggle is shown, but the snapshot renders one monthly figure plus the annual total per plan (Starter $25/mo and $300 billed annually; Ultimate $50/month/space and $600; Ultimate + $95/month/space and $1,140). Since 25x12=300 etc., the monthly figures may be annual-billed equivalents and the monthly-billed prices may not be rendered; the PO may want to check. Ultimate and Ultimate + are priced per space (extra spaces +$600 / +$1,140 per year are add-ons, not plans). Free is a real 'Forever free' plan (2 video and 10 text testimonials), hence pricing_status freemium. Enterprise shows 'Custom Pricing' / 'Contact us'. Prices are shown with '$' only; USD assumed. Name matching: 'ultimate' also matches 'Ultimate +'; the scorer should prefer the most specific match. The 'make' substring for the Make integration is short but only applied to reported integration names. Other stated integrations not listed (max 6): ChatGPT, Cursor, Grok, Notion, Framer, Squarespace, Carrd, Kajabi, Bubble, eGift cards; '100+ integrations' is a company claim. Exclusion: eligible; the footer 'Join affiliate program' is Testimonial's own incidental affiliate program, not its core purpose. Forbidden texts: the sample prompts in the MCP/Claude demo mock-ups (instruction-like text aimed at an AI assistant) and the spam example from the AI spam-filter demo. The demo inbox content (Acme, Maria López, '3X'd my conversions', NPS score 62, 847/2,000 mentions) is fictional UI mock-up data and must not be reported as facts. 'Trusted by 50,000+ businesses', 'Loved by Fortune 500 companies' and 'SOC 2 Type II compliant' are company claims, not payment proof. No company location, founding year or headcount is stated.
